title: OKDP mapping sections
description: The sections of a mapping (okdp.yaml, values.cel.yaml) the OKDP compiler reads, once evaluated: every compile checks them after the mapping and reports every violation at once. okdpGeneratedSecret is not a section: it is the argument of the host function, checked at each call. vars and errors are the mapping language's. A null section is not set, a null chart of output not rendered; elsewhere, as in a chart's values, a null deletes a default and is refused where there is none.

output.description: Chart key -> the values the mapping computes for the chart, a map. Every dependency of Chart.yaml is rendered, {} when the values file does not write its key, but one whose key it writes that is left out ($if) or null. Each key must be a dependency of Chart.yaml, checked with the final values. A package writes it as values.cel.yaml.

instance.description: The instance, in okdp.info.yaml with the connections it provides. Other keys are ignored.

usage.description: How to use the instance, trimmed, with one final newline when not empty.

provides.description: The connections the instance publishes, each then checked against its contract.

items.description: An output. Other keys are ignored.

name.description: The output's name, unique per contract, the one other instances of the namespace reference it by; the release name when absent or empty.

secretRef.description: The Secret holding the secret fields: {} is not set; only name is kept. Absent, the Secret of secret, <name>-<contract>-credentials. A claimer of another namespace reads a copy, <release>-<name>, which no other object of its namespace may write (CompileAll).

name.description: A Secret's name, a DNS-1123 subdomain: DNS-1123 labels (lowercase letters, digits and -, a letter or digit at each end) joined by dots, as a claim's ID.

secret.description: The credentials Secret the compiler renders, named after secretRef: generated (generate, the keys of okdpGeneratedSecret, and stringData for the keys that are not secret) or plain (stringData, strings only), which the compile refuses unless Inputs.AllowPlainSecrets: credentials in clear in the deployments repository. Other keys are ignored.

objects.description: OKDP's own objects, whole manifests, passed as written. Those of an instance of a project that is not privileged (global.okdp.policy.privileged) stay in its namespace (metadata.namespace unset, or the release's), and none is of a cluster-scoped kind: the compile refuses them. In every project, no Secret holds values in clear (data, stringData) unless Inputs.AllowPlainSecrets: okdpGeneratedSecret, or an ExternalSecret of the platform's secret store.

oidcClients.description: The OAuth clients of the service. The compiler then checks that one client at most has no name (the main client), that names are unique and, in dcr mode, that no two clients write one Secret.

name.description: "" or absent: the service's main client. Else the client's name, a DNS label of 54 characters at most: it names the chart <name>-oidc-dcr (a DNS label), its objects and its Secret.

grantTypes.description: The OAuth grant types the client registers.

scope.description: The scope it requests; "" or absent: platform.oidc.scope.

clientName.description: Its name at the identity provider; "" or absent: <release>-<namespace>[-<name>].

public.description: A public client, without a client secret; absent: false.

request.description: Fields of the registration request, over the computed ones.

secret.description: The Secret the Job writes the client to, the release's, <release>-<client name> exactly (<release>-oidc for the main client); "" or absent: oidcClientSecret(<name>).

caSecret.description: The Secret holding the CA bundle the Job trusts; "" or absent: platform.oidc.dcr.caSecret.

okdpJob.description: Not a section: the argument of okdpJob, a Job on the hardened pod of okdpPodSpec.

component.description: The component label (app.kubernetes.io/component) of the Job and its pod; "" or absent: none.

pod.description: The pod, the arguments of okdpPodSpec; restartPolicy Never unless it sets one.

backoffLimit.description: The retries before the Job fails; absent: 1.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: How long the finished Job is kept, for its logs; absent: 300.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: The time the Job may run; absent: no deadline.

hook.description: The Job as a hook of the release: Helm's (the umbrella renders the objects), and Argo CD's.

labels.description: Extra labels of the Job, over OKDP's.

podLabels.description: Extra labels of its pod, over OKDP's.

annotations.description: Extra annotations of the Job, over the hooks'.

okdpWebWorkload.description: Not a section: the argument of okdpWebWorkload, a web workload on the hardened pod of okdpPodSpec.

component.description: The workload's component (app.kubernetes.io/component): its selector, and its name, okdpFullname(component), unless name is set. Absent: none, the workload is the instance's own, named okdpFullname().

name.description: The name of its Deployment, Service, Ingress and NetworkPolicy; absent: okdpFullname(component).

pod.description: The pod, the arguments of okdpPodSpec; its first container is the application. The sign-in proxy and the volume are added to it.

port.description: The application's port, a name or a number of its container's ports; a number with signIn.

strategy.description: Absent: Recreate with a volume, which is ReadWriteOnce, else RollingUpdate.

storage.description: A PersistentVolumeClaim, named <name>-<volumeName>, and the pod's volume of that name: the application mounts it (volumeMounts of its container).

keep.description: Kept on uninstall (helm.sh/resource-policy: keep); absent: true.

ingress.description: An Ingress, host the project's (the compile refuses another, global.okdp.policy.ingressHosts), the platform's class and annotations.

signIn.description: The sign-in proxy in front of the application, a sidecar of the pod: the arguments of okdpSignInProxy; its host is the ingress's and its upstream the application's port on the pod's loopback unless it sets its own. Needs an ingress and a numeric port.

networkPolicy.description: With signIn, a NetworkPolicy letting in the proxy's port alone; absent: true.

labels.description: Extra labels of every object, over OKDP's.

okdpGeneratedSecret.description: Not a section: the argument of okdpGeneratedSecret, the objects of a Secret whose random values External Secrets Operator generates.

name.description: The Secret, and the ExternalSecret writing it.

labels.description: Extra labels of the ExternalSecret and the Secret.

namespace.description: The namespace of every object; "" or absent: the release's. Another namespace: the platform's projects only (global.okdp.policy.privileged), the compile refuses it otherwise.

refreshInterval.description: The ExternalSecret's refresh interval; "" or absent: "0", generated once.

apiVersion.description: The ExternalSecret's apiVersion; "" or absent: external-secrets.io/v1.

container.description: A container of okdpPodSpec: a container's own fields but its security context, which the fragment sets.

image.description: By digest (repository:tag@sha256:...) for a package that is reviewed for it.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Absent: true. false for an image that writes its root filesystem.

runAsUser.description: Absent: the image's user, which must not be root.

podSpec.description: The argument of okdpPodSpec: the containers and volumes of a pod, hardened. No security context, host namespace or hostPath volume.

signInProxy.description: The argument of okdpSignInProxy: oauth2-proxy in front of a service, with the platform's OIDC.

host.description: The host the users reach the service at: the OAuth client's redirect URL is https://<host>/oauth2/callback. Required (okdpSignInProxy); okdpWebWorkload sets it.

upstream.description: The URL of the service the proxy fronts. Required (okdpSignInProxy); okdpWebWorkload sets it.

name.description: The Secret of the cookie secret, generated once, and the cookie's name unless cookieName is set; absent: okdpFullname('oauth2-proxy').

allowedGroups.description: The groups let in, of the groups claim; absent: platform.access.editors, the project's editors and admins and the platform's administrators. Empty fails: it would let in the realm.

caBundleSecret.description: The Secret holding ca.crt, which the proxy trusts calling the issuer; absent: global.okdp.tls.caBundleSecret.

upstreamTimeout.description: A duration (1h) for a service that holds a request open; absent: the proxy's.

generatedKey.description: A generated key: the key of the Secret, and the Password generating its value.

transform.description: The key holds the value's sha256sum, or its base64; "" or absent: the value.
